root_cause.text: The amphion driver implemented a no-op device_run and a job_abort that unconditionally finished the job, creating a race condition where v4l2_m2m_ctx_release() could free the m2m_ctx while a pending device_run call (from v4l2_m2m_try_run) was about to use it.
root_cause.evidence: The race sequence in the CVE description shows that during v4l2_m2m_ctx_release(), v4l2_m2m_cancel_job() calls job_abort() which invokes v4l2_m2m_job_finish(), then kfree(m2m_ctx) frees the context. Concurrently, v4l2_m2m_try_run() calls device_run() on the freed context, causing a use-after-free crash (virtual address 0x538). The patch removes the job_abort callback and adds a job_ready callback returning 0 to prevent the m2m framework from scheduling jobs, eliminating the race.
